Fala

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Old Galician-Portuguese pero, from Late Latin per hoc (“for this reason”, literally “through this”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈpeɾu/
  • Rhymes: -eɾu
  • Syllabification: pe‧ru

Conjunction

[edit]

peru

  1. alternative form of pero (“but”)

References

[edit]
  • Valeš, Miroslav (2021), Diccionariu de A Fala: lagarteiru, mañegu, valverdeñu (web)‎[1], 2nd edition, Minde, Portugal: CIDLeS, published 2022, →ISBN, page 222

Finnish

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

perä +‎ -u

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈperu/, [ˈpe̞ru]
  • Rhymes: -eru
  • Syllabification(key): pe‧ru
  • Hyphenation(key): pe‧ru

Noun

[edit]

peru

  1. (usually figurative, sometimes in the plural) heritage (property that may be inherited; inherited traditions)
    Synonym: perintö
    Tämä kirjakokoelma on isoäitini peruja.
    This book collection was left by my grandmother.
  2. (figuratively) origin (beginning, source)
    Synonym: alkuperä
    olla ikivanhaa perua ― to be of ancient origin
Usage notes
[edit]

Only some cases are used in practice, and the word is essentially obsolete except in some idiomatic uses. In frequent use are the derived legal terms perukirja and perunkirjoitus.

Javanese

Javanese writing system
Carakan ꦥꦼꦫꦸ
Pegon
Roman peru

Etymology

[edit]

From Old Javanese (h)amp(ĕ)ru, from Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *qapəju, from Proto-Austronesian *qapəjux.

Noun

[edit]

pĕru

  1. gall; gall bladder
  2. bile
  3. pancreas

peru f

singular plural

Portuguese

[edit]
Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:
peru
Wikipedia pt

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • perú (1931-prescribed spelling or misspelling)

Etymology

[edit]

    From Peru (“Peru, also frequently used as a pars pro toto to refer to all the Spanish settlements in America”).

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
     
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /piˈɾu/, /peˈɾu/
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /piˈɾu/, /peˈɾu/
      • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /peˈɾu/
    • (Portugal) IPA(key): /pɨˈɾu/

    • Audio (Brazil (Caipira)):(file)
    • Homophone: Peru
    • Rhymes: -u
    • Hyphenation: pe‧ru

    Noun

    [edit]

    peru m (plural perus, feminine perua, feminine plural peruas)

    1. wild turkey (Meleagris gallopavo)
      Synonym: peru-selvagem
    2. (loosely) turkey (any bird in the genus Meleagris)

    Derived terms

    [edit]
    • peru-ocelado
    • peru-selvagem
    • perua
    • peruzão
    • peruzinho

    Descendants

    [edit]
    • → Hunsrik: Biru

    Noun

    [edit]

    peru m (uncountable)

    1. turkey (flesh or meat of the turkey eaten as food)

    Noun

    [edit]

    peru m (plural perus)

    1. (Portugal, soccer) a goal resulting from a shameful mistake by the goalkeeper
      Synonym: frango
    2. (Brazil, vulgar) penis
      Synonyms: see Thesaurus:pénis

    References

    [edit]
    • “peru”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
    • “peru”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026
    • “peru”, in Dicionário infopédia da Lingua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Porto: Porto Editora, 2003–2026
    • “peru”, in Michaelis Dicionário Brasileiro da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), São Paulo: Editora Melhoramentos, 2015–2026, →ISBN
